title: Agent generates a frame-scaled scatter from intent
prompt:
Create a Viva artifact that plots pressure vs time as a scatter.

CRITICAL SYNTAX:
- Declare `frame plot` as a TOP-LEVEL block (sibling of `scene`), NEVER indented under scene.
- Frame body uses `x:`, `y:` (scene ranges) plus `xlim:` / `ylim:` (data domain).
- Marks use property `frame: plot` (not a nested frame block).

Include at least 4 data points and one layer of circle marks with frame: plot.
Output ONLY valid Viva source starting with artifact.
